item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani today concludes the first state visit by a Qatari Amir to Switzerland, after official…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani today concludes the first state visit by a Qatari Amir to Switzerland, after official talks on Wednesday with President Guy Parmelin at the Bernerhof in Bern and an official welcome ceremony at the Swiss Parliament building. The Qatari delegation included the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister and the ministers of finance, energy, and commerce and industry. Swiss Ambassador to Qatar Florence Tinguely Mattli said the visit opens new avenues in mediation, humanitarian work, innovation and investment, and that expected outcomes include a Joint Economic and Financial Commission, an MoU between the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation and the Qatar Fund for Development, a tourism agreement and a Swiss Pavilion at Web Summit Qatar 2027. The Amir then moves on to a state visit to Germany on 20 and 21 November.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/amirs-visit-to-open-new-avenues-for-cooperation · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738568/qatar/hh-the-amir-swiss-president-eye-broader-horizons

item.title: The Malaysian Embassy in Doha launched the Malaysia Business Executive Council – Qatar (MBEC) at a trade and investment roundtable held on …
item.description:
The Malaysian Embassy in Doha launched the Malaysia Business Executive Council – Qatar (MBEC) at a trade and investment roundtable held on Wednesday at The St. Regis Doha. Qatar Chamber First Vice-Chairman Mohamed bin Ahmed bin Twar Al Kuwari said bilateral trade reached about QR2.5bn last year and could double in the coming years, citing opportunities in energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, food security, IT, tourism and logistics. Malaysian Ambassador Faizal Razali said economic ties "are no longer just a diplomacy talking point; they are a thriving reality," describing Qatar as a strategic gateway to the Gulf for Islamic finance and smart infrastructure.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/qatar-malaysia-deepen-economic-ties-with-launch-of-business-council · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265442/business/qatar-malaysia-seek-to-double-bilateral-trade-to-qr5-billion

item.title: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Wednesday concluded its seven-day "National Product Week" across malls and outlets nationwide. It …
item.description:
The Ministry of Commerce and Industry on Wednesday concluded its seven-day "National Product Week" across malls and outlets nationwide. It included three workshops by the National Product Competitiveness Support Department, the Finance Ministry's Government Procurement Department and Qatar Development Bank, and field visits by more than 400 students from 17 schools to four national factories including Baladna. The initiative aims to raise awareness of national industry, protect it from harmful practices and support self-sufficiency and diversification.

item.title: Doha has received Platinum-level certification, the highest awarded by the World Council on City Data (WCCD), under ISO 37120 for city serv…
item.description:
Doha has received Platinum-level certification, the highest awarded by the World Council on City Data (WCCD), under ISO 37120 for city services and quality of life, along with certification under the Smart Cities (ISO 37122) and Resilient Cities (ISO 37123) standards. The Ministry of Municipality led the effort with 13 partner government entities to build an integrated urban data and indicators system supporting data-driven planning.

item.title: The seventh Qatar Luxury Classic Cars Contest & Exhibition 2026 opened at The Pearl Island under the honorary patronage of Sheikha Al Mayas…
item.description:
The seventh Qatar Luxury Classic Cars Contest & Exhibition 2026 opened at The Pearl Island under the honorary patronage of Sheikha Al Mayassa bint Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, Chairperson of Qatar Museums, with a record 74 rare vehicles, about 50% from GCC countries, the oldest a 1928 Ford Model A. Cars compete in five categories covering vehicles made between 1900 and 1996 for 20 cash and in-kind awards judged to FIVA standards; the exhibition runs until 22 November, when winners are announced.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/19/11/2026/qatar-luxury-classic-cars-exhibition-opens-at-the-pearl-island · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265039/latest-news/qatar-luxury-classic-cars-contest-exhibition-2026-kicks-off

item.title: Air defences intercepted a Houthi missile fired towards Riyadh early on Thursday, after a Civil Defence alert at 4:42am followed by a loud …
item.description:
Air defences intercepted a Houthi missile fired towards Riyadh early on Thursday, after a Civil Defence alert at 4:42am followed by a loud explosion about three minutes later. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said an initial assessment found falling debris and material damage still being assessed. Sources told AFP that the facade of the 80-storey tower housing the Public Investment Fund headquarters in the financial district was damaged across several floors with windows blown out; no casualties were reported.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/coalition-forces-intercept-houthi-missile-launched-towards-riyadh-debris-causes-damage-3012860 · Türkiye Today https://www.turkiyetoday.com/region/saudi-wealth-funds-riyadh-tower-damaged-as-houthi-missile-hits-capital-3232736 · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-houthi-missiles-targeting-riyadh-and-south

item.title: The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said on Thursday it destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Dhamar used by the Houthi…
item.description:
The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said on Thursday it destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Dhamar used by the Houthis in the attempted attack on Riyadh, and a second platform in Saada province, and intercepted a cruise missile and ballistic missiles fired towards the Kingdom's southern region, as sirens sounded in Khamis Mushait and Abha. The Houthis claimed to have targeted King Khalid International Airport and the financial centre in Riyadh, and the Houthi-run Saba agency reported Saudi strikes on Sanaa on Thursday morning.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738584/region/coalition-forces-ballistic-missile-launch-platform-used-by-houthi-group-destroyed · Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/19/saudi-led-coalition-intercepts-houthi-missiles-targeting-riyadh-and-south · Social News XYZ (IANS) https://www.socialnews.xyz/2026/11/19/damage-reported-in-riyadh-after-houthi-missile-intercepted/

item.title: Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman received US Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper in Riyadh, discussing bilateral, esp…
item.description:
Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman received US Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper in Riyadh, discussing bilateral, especially military, relations and regional developments, with Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman, the National Security Adviser and the Chief of the General Staff attending. It is Cooper's third publicly reported visit to the Kingdom since hostilities with the Houthis reignited in July.

item.title: Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council Chairman Rashad al-Alimi issued Law No. 1 of 2026 designating the Houthi group a "terrorist organis…
item.description:
Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council Chairman Rashad al-Alimi issued Law No. 1 of 2026 designating the Houthi group a "terrorist organisation" in all its political, military, security, media and economic formations, after approval by the cabinet and parliament. The law sets 20 to 30 years in prison, up to death, for terrorist acts and 10 to 15 years for joining the group; it allows asset freezes but confiscation only by final court ruling, and exempts UN and ICRC humanitarian work, transport of food, medicine and fuel, and authorised peace talks.
Sources: A News (Anadolu) https://www.anews.com.tr/middle-east/2026/11/18/yemen-classifies-houthis-terrorist-organization-under-new-law · Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5342820-yemen-law-criminalizes-houthi-activities-opens-door-domestic-and-international

item.title: The International Energy Agency, in its annual World Energy Outlook released on Thursday, called the Middle East crisis the "largest threat…
item.description:
The International Energy Agency, in its annual World Energy Outlook released on Thursday, called the Middle East crisis the "largest threat to energy security in history," after the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, which carried about one-fifth of global oil shipments, curbed Gulf exports. Executive Director Fatih Birol said consumers increasingly bear the burden as other buffers run down and that "the longer the crisis lasts, the deeper the effects will be," adding he sees no "credible pathway" back to the pre-crisis energy world. The report adds two scenarios for a persisting crisis and, under stated policies, sees oil demand peaking around 2030.
Sources: Oman Observer (AFP) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199928/business/mideast-crisis-largest-threat-to-energy-security-ever-iea · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/energy/mid-east-crisis-largest-threat-to-energy-security-ever-iea-1.500753037

item.description:
CAPMAS said unemployment rose to 6.0% in the third quarter of 2026 from 5.8% in the second, with 2.162 million unemployed, up 87,000 (4.2%), while the labour force grew 0.3% to 35.757 million. The rate was 3.6% for men and 14.9% for women, and 9% in urban areas against 3.7% in rural areas.

item.title: Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty told Al Qahera News from Washington that Egypt works continuously to de-escalate in the region in coordinat…
item.description:
Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty told Al Qahera News from Washington that Egypt works continuously to de-escalate in the region in coordination with GCC states, Pakistan, Turkiye and the United States, and is in contact with Iran in the hope of calm and a return to negotiations; he called Congress's honouring of the late President Anwar Sadat an honour for Egypt. He said the first phase of the Gaza plan has not been fully implemented, with the 600-trucks-a-day aid target unmet because of Israeli obstacles, and second-phase talks have not begun. Abdelatty had also discussed de-escalation by phone with Omani counterpart Badr Al Busaidi, with both stressing that "military solutions do not end crises."
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/19/%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%81%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%B6/7624218 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7186405 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2531392 · Masr 2030 https://www.msr2030.com/596065

item.title: The Ministry of Health and Population announced the end of the national measles and rubella vaccination campaign, with 20,890,167 children …
item.description:
The Ministry of Health and Population announced the end of the national measles and rubella vaccination campaign, with 20,890,167 children vaccinated, 99.1% coverage of a target of about 21 million children aged 9 months to 10 years, over three weeks from 25 October with 77,611 medical and administrative staff. An independent field evaluation found 98% coverage so far, and vaccination continues at health units for children who missed the campaign.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/18/%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%85-20-8-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84-%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A9-99-1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AE%D8%AA%D8%AA%D9%85/7623430 · Khalf El Hadth https://khalfelhadth.com/160564

item.title: US President Donald Trump said at the start of talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC summit in Shenzhen…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump said at the start of talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC summit in Shenzhen that the two countries agree on keeping the Strait of Hormuz open and that Iran "cannot have a nuclear weapon," adding "we both feel that very strongly," and that both want to help end the Russia-Ukraine war. Xi did not immediately respond publicly. Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin would join them later for a trilateral meeting, after a brief preparatory meeting with Putin; Trump is expected to raise denuclearisation, Taiwan and trade.
Sources: EDNews https://ednews.net/en/trump-xi-agrees-strait-of-hormuz-must-stay-open-iran-must-have-no/ · Open Magazine (ANI) https://openthemagazine.com/world/trump-says-us-china-believe-in-end-to-russia-ukraine-war-no-nukes-for-iran-very-strongly · CBS News https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-xi-putin-china-apec-summit/

item.title: Korea's Kospi closed Thursday at 5,137.89, up 70.45 points (1.39%) after a volatile session, and the Kosdaq jumped 3.32% to 684.81, led by …
item.description:
Korea's Kospi closed Thursday at 5,137.89, up 70.45 points (1.39%) after a volatile session, and the Kosdaq jumped 3.32% to 684.81, led by SK hynix (+3.41%) and Samsung Electronics (+1.13%), while the won firmed to 1,330 per dollar. In Tokyo the Nikkei closed at 59,444.21, up 0.71% for a second gain, supported by SoftBank Group (+4.5%), while the Topix slipped 0.04% to 3,822.47 and the non-ferrous metals index fell 2.8% on weaker gold and copper, as investors awaited Anthropic's Nasdaq debut.

item.title: Oil moved in a narrow range on Thursday morning after a sharp drop yesterday: Brent was at $92.12 a barrel (+0.18%) at 02:37 GMT, then abou…
item.description:
Oil moved in a narrow range on Thursday morning after a sharp drop yesterday: Brent was at $92.12 a barrel (+0.18%) at 02:37 GMT, then about $91.70 (−0.2%) in later trade, with US crude between $82.70 and $83.17. The US EIA reported a 3.4 million-barrel crude build to 417.8 million barrels against expectations of just 58,000, and a 5.2 million-barrel gasoline build, while unverified Iranian reports of three tankers disabled by mines east of Hormuz limited losses.

item.title: Spot gold held at $3,722.84 an ounce at 04:52 GMT after touching $3,693.13, its lowest since September 2025, while US futures fell 0.5% to …
item.description:
Spot gold held at $3,722.84 an ounce at 04:52 GMT after touching $3,693.13, its lowest since September 2025, while US futures fell 0.5% to $3,723.90 and silver rose 0.3% to $45.14. Markets price a 90% chance of a quarter-point US rate hike in December and 10% for half a point, after October minutes showed inflation concern. OCBC analysts said the break below $3,800 "risks reinforcing bearish sentiment."
Sources: Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449691/gold-holds-near-14-month-low-as-fed-hike-bets-weigh · ATFX https://www.atfxcapital.com/en/analysis/market-news/20261119-daily-market-highlight

item.title: US stock futures rose on Thursday morning ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut after it priced its IPO at $83 a share in the largest IPO on re…
item.description:
US stock futures rose on Thursday morning ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut after it priced its IPO at $83 a share in the largest IPO on record, following yesterday's session in which the Dow fell 1.11% to 50,198 and the S&P 500 0.23% to 7,323 while the Nasdaq rose 0.42%. The dollar index rose 0.18% to 103.89 at yesterday's close and the 10-year Treasury yield eased to 5.068%. Markets await US jobless claims and a speech by ECB President Christine Lagarde today.
